name: mosaikit-workspace
description: Frontend of Mosaikit as npm workspaces: plugin SDK and kernel UI. The Maven build runs it.
author: Massimo Antonini

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p docs/requirements && tsc -p docs/test && tsc -p sdk/java
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build
